data.name: Nuvio
data.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
data.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.
data.versionDescription:
Nuvio 0.5.9 | nuvio-0.5.9-full-release

- 1bb2b10e feat(servers): sync libraries that mix movies and shows @tapframe  
- 6f98691d fix(servers): mark playback info requests as playback @tapframe  
- e05178c8 feat(servers): show libraries that mix movies and shows @tapframe  
- de69f9a9 fix(servers): open libraries that need a genre on their first one @tapframe  
- c2ed4c5e fix(servers): skip versions that cannot play @tapframe  
- 5a24beb0 fix(servers): search each server once per type @tapframe  
- [i18n(vi): update strings.xml and add strings_mdblist.xml + strings_servers.xml (#2216)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2216) @blueocean2308  
- [Fix TorBox Cloud loading for large libraries (#2215)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2215) @Laskco  
- [Defer custom poster URL resolution to UI layer (#2207)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2207) @skoruppa  
- [fix(i18n): comprehensive update to Bengali localization (missing strings & UI fit) (#2204)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2204) @TanvirSdq
